narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>For forty two, I divide by three and keep fourteen, and my sister takes twenty eight.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Fourteen to twenty eight is one to two, not four to three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Dividing by one term alone breaks the ratio, so that slip is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 42 ÷ 3 = 14 for Joseph and 28 for the sister; 14 : 28 = 1 : 2 is written; the bubble is struck in the warning colour
